clip.title: CEO proposal and member voting
clip.text: The CEO may now add a custom response alongside the three prepared choices. Review every option, then each member chooses and confirms their own vote in the app. A new option resets voting for everyone. After all votes, the CEO confirms the winner, or chooses among tied leaders. Spoken agreement does not count as a vote.

generation.note: Fictional prerecorded fixtures, not live responses. No provider calls are needed for replay.
